en: Oh! Wonderful!
Don't worry. I'm sure those two will come back someday.
I know everything is hard right now. I know you miss them.
But they care so much for you... truly. They will return. You'll all be together again.
Until then, stay strong, and just keep doing what you've been doing. You're already helping your family a lot.
Gee, Sawamura-san.
Oh! I'm sorry. I...
No, no need to apologize. It's just⑬I don't know if what you said is true. How would anybody know if those two will return? But... I'll still print what you said. No edits.
Oh! Thank you!
You know what? Shame on your mother and father for leaving you all behind.
That said, they probably already feel guilty about it. That feeling will make them come home someday.
You just have to hold on a little longer. You're obviously an upstanding young man, and the children all look up to you.
Keep doing what you've been doing. You're already helping your family a lot.
No need to apologize. You obviously have strong feelings about the situation. I think your words might be what "Dragon Mask Man" needs to hear. I'll print them without any edits.
Those were some fascinating answers. Thank you for coming.
And thank you very much for having me!
I have to say, I was surprised at how honestly you spoke. There aren't many who would be so direct with their fans, let alone fans who are children.
Oh... I'm very sorry.
No worries. You're a sincere person who's simply trying to help.
Um, would it be possible for me to read the rest of the letters that were sent in?
Oh, sure. I actually have them right here. Shall I have them sent to your agency?
No, I'd like to take them with me now, if that's all right.
Are you sure? That's a lot of heavy paper to carry around!
It's okay! I'm stronger than I look.
Hahaha! You got it, then.
And here's some compensation for your time.
Best of luck to you in your career.
That's very kind of you. Goodbye!
You gave some fantastic answers. I'm sure the children who wrote the letters will be thrilled.
Oh, I hope so!
We hope to have you back soon.
I'd like that very much.
It's the lamb barbecue girl! Hey! Snap out of it! Wake up!
Ngh... Urf...
It's me! C'mon, wake up! Open yer eyes, barbecue girl!
It's... Yamashita... Mami Yamashita...
Did ya really come lookin' for deer meat? This is nuts.
Oh... Oh, that's right! Deer! Where are the deer? Have to catch a deer.
Ridiculous. You can't hunt deer without a gun. We gotta get ya off the mountain. Assumin' you don't wanna die.
But... I want some nice gamey deer!
I'll get ya all you can eat once we're off the mountain. But right now, ya follow me.
You promise? Okay, as long as I get my deer stew!
That was absolutely fabulous. I'm never happier than when I'm eating good food.
You okay with springin' for dinner?
Of course! I ate most of it, after all.
Good point.
Oh! I almost forgot...
Would you tell me the tastiest thing you've eaten recently?
It's something I always ask whenever I meet someone new. That's how I found out about Matsuo Lamb Barbeque!
This question has led me to so many delicious food discoveries, so I'm certainly going to keep asking it!
I gotcha. All right, the tastiest thing recently... Well it had to be deer stew.
Deer stew? I've never had that!
I had it in this one hunting village. Got lost in a blizzard, and the man who saved me gave me some. Best meal of my life.
What did it taste like?
Ya know, I'd heard deer has a partic'lar odor to it, but all I know is this stuff smelled great. Coulda been the miso, I guess.
They don't boil the deer meat all the way through; they serve it while it's nice n' tender. Whole thing was fantastic.
Wow, a brand new flavor...
One I've never tried before! I can't wait to taste it.
Well, next time I'm on the mountain, I'll hunt ya some deer⑬it'll be my thanks for the lamb barbecue.
No, no, that would take too long. Once a dish is in my mind, I want it in my stomach too, as soon as possible!
You mean... now? But we just ate.
Oh, I can always find room for new flavors. No time to waste!
Thank you very much, Saejima-san. I'm heading up the mountain for some deer stew!
(She serious about going up the mountain?)
(No, can't be. No one's that extreme a foodie, are they?)
This is it, right? Matsuo Lamb Barbeque.
Yes! Finally, I can enjoy the legendary lamb barbecue.
All right, little lady. Mind if I go now?
Wait! Let me treat you to dinner. As thanks for bringing me here!
No need for that. Haven't fallen so low that I'd let a young person feed me.
Please. Aren't people your age always asking young people to show more gratitude?
Heh. All right. Nice comeback.
Wonderful. My name is Mami Yamashita. I'm a food journalist.
So, you're eatin' here for yer job?
Oh, no. This is my private time. So, there's no problem with me treating you.
All right, then. I'm Saejima.
Let's not waste any time, Saejima-san! The lamb barbecue here is legendary!
The lambs are selected from the best flocks in New Zealand, and the sauce is made according to a secret recipe that took ten years to perfect!
Everyone says this place blows its competitors away.
Heh. Ya know all about the joint before a single bite!
Well, its reputation is why I've been fasting since yesterday!
Huh? Ya said you were fastin' a long time. One day ain't a long time...
Wait, please! Could you take me to Matsuo Lamb Barbeque? I... I'm not sure I can stand up straight much longer.
Fine. Where is it?
On Nakatsuki Street.
All right, I'll take ya there. It's nearby.
Hey, little lady, what's wrong? Ya look like you're gonna faint.
I... I'm okay... Do you know Matsuo Lamb Barbeque? It's a restaurant.
Ya wanna know where it is?
No, I know where it is. I checked online.
So what's goin' on? Why're ya so unsteady on yer feet?
I've been fasting a really long time, because I'm getting ready to eat the best lamb barbecue ever!
An empty stomach is the best seasoning.
Nuts to that. I thought ya were in real trouble.
Saejima-san, why don't you let me order for the both of us? I've done all the research.
All right, then. It's on you, little lady.
So this is the famous lamb barbecue. Smells good.
Don't hold back! Let's eat!
Great stuff. The lamb ain't even gamey.
Isn't it amazing? It's leagues beyond other places with lamb barbecue.
Yum, this was so worth the fast! I could keep eating this forever!
(Wow, she's still goin'...)
*gulp* *snuffle* *gulp*
(Incredible.)
Mmm... so good.
Hey, ya done yet? I gotta go... though I am amazed at how you can put it away.
Heh, this is normal for me! I usually eat about three big bowls of just rice. I love rice!
By the way, Saejima-san, what do you do for work?
Uh... Well... This and that.
I see. *snuffle* *gulp*
What about you? You a food journalist full time?
Unfortunately, no. I also do some acting, like in TV dramas.
Well, that's interestin'.
Oh, I'm not a big star or anything. But I like it, and I also want to do voice acting eventually.
Um... may I ask you something? It's important.
Uh, what is it? Come on. Spit it out.
I think I might order more barbecue. Do you mind?
Oh, hey, Saejima! Just the kind of guy we need!
Somethin' wrong?
This weird girl came up from Tsukimino. I think she started to scale the mountain by herself.
Huh? What happened, exactly?
She was saying things like, "The deer stew is calling me." Her eyes were all bloodshot, too. Kind of scary-looking.
(It can't be... The lamb barbecue girl? She actually came up here?)
If you're going up the mountain, maybe keep an eye out for her?
I'm really hoping she didn't go up there, but no one saw her leave by the other route. I'm worried.
I wouldn't count on her givin' up, not when there's food involved. I'll look for her.
Thank you, Saejima-san!
Saejima-san, don't forget your promise of deer stew!
Heh. Never.
But I'm gonna need a bit more time to hunt deer.
Oh, I understand. I can wait. I'll stay hungry!
Ya know, I'm impressed with how committed ya are. Makes this whole thing worth it.
But I ain't ready yet.
Oh. Ok... but remember you promised! I'll wait for you and stay hungry.
All right, let's go inside the hut. I'll cook some deer stew for ya.
Oh, thank you, Saejima-san!
Whew. Made it back alive.
Saejima-san! Thank you so much!
You're awful perky. Ya always bounce back so quick from almost freezin'?
Oh, it's because I'm so excited about your promise! You haven't forgotten about making me deer stew, have you?
So this is deer stew. It's delicious! So different from anything I've ever tasted before.
No doubt. Just so ya know, little lady, it's also delicious when you're not starvin' yerself.
It was worth everything I did.
I always liked deer⑬they're so cute! But now I think I'll be looking at them in a different light.
Heh, a lady who gets hungry seein' deer.
Haha, yep, that's me!
But stop bein' so reckless, will ya? No more goin' off into the snowy wilds.
I'm so sorry! With food, I can hardly control myself...
But thanks to you, I got back safely, and I got deer stew. You're my hero.

So... I'd like you to have this, a small token of my appreciation.
Thank you for everything!
You're good!
So I won?

Yeah, fair and square. I guess I underestimated you,
thinking you were just some silly idol.

Can't really call myself a dancer anymore, can I? Maybe
I'll stick to talk shows.
Gee, Kurata-san, I⑬
Haruka!
Yamaura-san! How did you know where I was?
What're ya doin' here with Ayu!?
Well, you see⑬
Misa. You sure found a good one in this girl, didn't ya?
Idols do all kinds of things, right? They don't just perform. They get their pictures taken, make appearances on variety shows, greet fans at events...

So I always thought they didn't have time to focus on
training and nobody cared if they couldn't dance.

I never understood why people fawned all over the no-talent
idols and ignored us real entertainers.

So imagine how surprised I was to find out there's an idol
who takes such pride in her performance on stage, both
singing and dancing.
Kurata-san...
Well, we never were idols, that's for sure.

But we sang and danced up there on the stage, just like they
do. I wish we could have gone further together, you and me.
But I guess it just wasn't meant to be.
Ayu...

Nowadays, I'm a TV personality, and I never sing or dance
anymore, but, truth be told, I still miss it.

Don't you miss it, too, Misa? Don't ya just hate bein'
nothing but a voice coach?
Well, I...

I'm a lousy singer, but you? Doesn't it just rankle ya to
hafta listen to terrible, amateur singing all day when you
know you're so much better?
I bet ya still miss the old days, just like I do⑬

I may not cling to my old dreams like you do, but that
doesn't mean I've given up on dreams altogether.
My new dream is to see this kid here have a successful debut.
Yamaura-san!
Misa...

The same is true for Park, Horie, and Christina, too.
Show business is a place where dreams are passed on from one
to another.

So it didn't work out for me. At least I can still help make
someone else's dream come true. That's what keeps me going.

Otherwise, I would've left this business ages ago and found
myself a husband or something.
Heh, same old Misa.

Haruka, you've got yourself a great teacher here, so you
better study hard and have a hell of a debut, or you'll be
hearing from me!
I will!

Also, Misa, I dunno why ya think you'd find a husband so
easily. You looked in a mirror lately?

Ha! What about you!? All these years in the business, and I
haven't heard jack squat about your love life.

That's because I keep my private life private. Ya don't need
to worry about my love affairs, thank you very much.
Oh, yeah? Name one boyfriend, then! Ya can't, can ya!?
Hehe... Hahaha!
You two really do like each other after all, don't you?
We do not!
Now whaddya want? Come to pick another fight?

I still want you to take back what you said about singing
skill not being important!

That stuff again? I bet you're just all hung up on singing
because you're a terrible dancer.
That's not true!

In that case, you know what I want. A dance battle, you
against me!

(It would be crazy to take on a former pro, but I can't let
her get away with the things she said. What do I do?)

What? Ya come lookin' for a fight then back out!? Pretty
pathetic, if you ask me...

But I guess that's about what I'd expect from a student of
Misa's. Whatever.
